title: Child-repo draft PRs open once claude-settings main is green; the switch waits for the drain to end
ruling: Owner 16:09 CST Nov 13, chat with the consultant, relayed 16:10 CST: "if main gets green then it can already open the draft pr but once the drain finishes should / can the switch happen". Act 6 of the merge-flow list: the one draft PR per child repo (q_max first) that gives each a stable branch and revert route may open once claude-settings main is green, meaning a run that ran its suites (a skipped run does not count unless a green PR run of that tree backs it, ruling own-769-a-narrowed-pr-push). The switch itself waits for the drain to end. Replaces the consultant's 16:08 filing (owner 16:07: "wait for the drain given main on claude-settings isn't green yet"). Cites decision all-repos-switch-together: every repo switches together, none alone. The 16:09 words end in a question about the switch; read as: the switch happens when the drain ends. Unconfirmed by the owner in those words.
